summary: Current-main expected-red support PR #493 proves the retained WorldEntity generation-10 lineage has not converged into main: the byte-identical reviewed +48-line world_entity regression delta passes all pre-test canonical gates but Pure Luau fails because main lacks MAX_PERSISTENT_STATE_STRING_BYTES.
